Question
========
Which Markdown syntax renders a word as both bold and italicized?

Answerlist
----------
* `*word*`
* `**word**`
* `***word***`
* `~~word~~`

Solution
========

Answerlist
----------
* Wrong: a single pair of asterisks renders italics only.
* Wrong: two pairs of asterisks render bold only.
* Correct: three asterisks combine both bold and italic emphasis.
* Wrong: double tildes render strikethrough, not bold or italic emphasis.
